subject: Can you resend the waiver?
text: Yes, that makes sense, and I appreciate you pulling the details together. Could you send me the signed expense waiver from last week? Our finance person found a small problem: the venue charged an unanticipated fee for projector setup, and it did not line up with the estimate. I think the waiver might cover it, but I want to check before anyone approves another purchase order. No rush by morning, though before Friday would be ideal so I can attach it to the budget note. If the file is buried, even a screenshot of the signature page works for now. Also, if there is a second document for the extra fee, please include it, because I would rather ask once than interrupt you repeatedly. Thanks for helping me avoid a silly delay.
